name: Luz y Luna
description: From discovery to a piece worth keeping

regions.label: Discover the collection
regions.summary: An editorial storefront leads from hero imagery to materials and curated products.
regions.visual: An elegant cream storefront window with three beautifully lit jewelry pieces and a flowing ribbon that invites exploration. No UI screens.

regions.label: Silver and gold tones
regions.summary: Material gateways distinguish silver and plated jewelry. Product categories guide browsing.
regions.visual: Two sculptural archways: brushed silver on the left, muted gold on the right. A ring and a pendant on stone plinths.

regions.label: One coherent catalog
regions.summary: Catalog layers connect product information and the storefront's browsing structure.
regions.visual: An open jewel box with organized velvet compartments, necklaces and rings, fine flowing lines connecting the collection.

regions.label: Stories and inspiration
regions.summary: Strapi supplies editorial hero content and blog posts; Medusa supplies commerce and catalog data.
regions.visual: An open editorial magazine with photographic jewelry shapes and botanical illustrations. All pages without letters.

regions.label: Confidence to choose
regions.summary: The storefront communicates delivery, WhatsApp help, guarantees and secure payment. These are presented promises, not audited service outcomes.
regions.visual: A beautifully wrapped small gift box, a protective glass dome and a tiny unlettered delivery van.

regions.label: Behind the experience
regions.summary: A storefront, commerce backend and content system support the customer journey. Implementation context remains available in the evidence panel.
regions.visual: Three graceful architectural pavilions connected by delicate metallic threads, representing the quiet system behind the experience.
